stories.title: "Our future is for the people who live here to decide," Falklands Assembly tells Milei
stories.summary: The Falkland Islands Legislative Assembly issued a statement on Friday in response to Argentine President Javier Milei's address, maintaining that the archipelago's future is for those who live there to decide. "The Falkland Islands are a self-governing British Overseas Territory, and our future is a matter for the people who live here to decide," the text says, adding that this is "a right grounded in international law" and that "it is not altered by the statements of any other government."
